name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: Madame Eva's foreboding points to a threat against Darkshire: Stalvan Mistmantle, a killer with a family ring. You are asked to confront him and bring the ring to her.

sections.title: A Threat to Darkshire
sections.body: Madame Eva's premonition has led you to Stalvan Mistmantle, whose crimes have brought fear to Darkshire. He is said to threaten the town from his cottage just north of it. You are asked to put an end to that danger and take his family ring to Madame Eva.

faq.answer: Stalvan Mistmantle is described as a killer responsible for many crimes, and he threatens Darkshire.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva send me after Stalvan?
faq.answer: Madame Eva's premonition led to the discovery of Stalvan's threat against Darkshire.
Stalvan's cottage is just north of Darkshire.

faq.q: What does Madame Eva ask me to bring back?
faq.answer: She asks you to show her Stalvan's family ring.

faq.q: What happened after Stalvan was killed?
faq.answer: Madame Eva says Stalvan is dead, and that Duskwood is free from his bloodthirst.
She sensed hope spread through the tainted forest after Stalvan's death, though she grieves for his victims.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Legend of Stalvan
